text:
elena: Hey team :wave: planning an APAC-friendly webinar for April 15 — need a localized asset pack and lead-routing spec. TL;DR: 3 locale variants (EN-US, EN-UK, JP), hero + social tiles + 2 slide templates + animated promo GIFs + accessible color variants. Deadline: EOD Tue (72h).

samir: Got it. Can you confirm exact time zone for the webinar and whether JP needs language-swapped copy or just different imagery? :eyes:

elena: Webinar time: 08:00 PDT / 16:00 BST / 00:00 JST (next day). JP needs translated copy (Japanese) for hero & social tiles, and one localized slide deck with speaker names + bios in JP. Imagery: APAC-forward photography for JP variant.

tara: I can draft the JP copy — will need speaker bios by EOD today. Also: short 1-liners for social (3 variations each) so we can A/B test CTAs.

samir: Ok — asset list + specs I'm taking:
- Hero: 1920x1080 (web), 1280x720 (web-small), 1200x628 (social link)
- Social tiles: 1080x1080 (IG), 1200x630 (FB/LI), 1080x1350 (IG tall)
- Animated promo GIFs: 800x450 (loop, 6s) + 600x600 (square, 6s)
- Slide templates: 16:9 master + 4:5 variant (for replay posts)
- Speaker headshots: 1:1 1400px min, transparent bg option
- Export: PNG for stills, optimized GIF/WebM for motion, source .psd/.fig/.xd

Also need color-accessibility pass: provide 2 high-contrast colorways and WCAG AA text contrast for hero CTAs.

designbot: Export checklist:
```
- Hero (web): 1920x1080 @72dpi, sRGB, 2x export for retina
- Social 1200x628: 72dpi, sRGB
- GIFs: 6s loop, 24fps, under 3MB preferred
- Provide layered source + SVG logo + font stack notes
```

elena: Nice. For messaging: primary CTA is "Register — seats limited". Secondary CTA for JP: "無料で登録". UTM: utm_source=webinar, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=inference-econ-apac. Please bake UTM into social card demo links.

mike-sales: For lead routing — map registrations to CRM as follows:
- If country=JP -> assign to APAC SDR queue (queue_apac_jp)
- If country in [AU,SG,IN] -> APAC queue (queue_apac_regional)
- EU/UK -> EMEA SDR (queue_emea)
- US/CA -> NAMER SDR (queue_namer)
Include a boolean field `is_apac_webinar` on lead record. Also add `timezone_pref` if provided.

elena: Perfect. Also want a micro-form variant for JP landing page that requests timezone (picker) and consent checkbox (GDPR/PDPA note).

legal: Quick flags: avoid comparative claims like "cheaper than X" on hero. For translations, ensure privacy text in JP matches legal-approved phrasing — Tara, please run JP copy by me before final render.

tara: Will do. I have the draft JP hero copy, posting below for quick review: "Redwood Inferenceの最適化で、レイテンシとコストを一元管理。ウェビナーに今すぐ登録". Legal — pinging you to confirm PDPA phrasing.

legal: Thanks — I'll review and respond within 3 hours. If any claim references numbers, we need source footnotes in the slide deck.

samir: Design question: do we want a distinct visual lockup for JP hero (vertical type treatment) or keep consistent layout and swap copy/imagery? Vertical type might hurt global reuse.

elena: Keep layout consistent for faster turn. Use different imagery and copy. If time permits, create a vertical hero as an optional extra.

samir: Understood — I'll push initial PNG mocks in ~8 hours. Will include the two color-accessibility variants.

designbot: Uploaded export templates to shared: https://figma.com/file/abc123/apac-webinar-templates (dev link). Exports named: `APAC_WEB_HERO_EN-US.png`, `APAC_WEB_HERO_JP.png`, `APAC_SOC_1200x628_EN-UK.png`, etc.

elena: Great — tracker: please add final assets to the `marketing-assets/webinars/apac-2026` folder and tag with `webinar/apac/2026-04-15`. Also add delivery note with final file sizes.

mike-sales: One more: CRM mapping rule should also include utm_campaign value for attribution. If utm_campaign=="inference-econ-apac" set campaign_source = "webinar_apac_apr2026".

tara: I'll prepare social 1-liners and 3 headline variants for A/B test by EOD.

samir: Quick QA items I'm adding to the Figma file: font fallback notes (Inter -> system), accessible link underline option, and alt-text suggestions for each image.

elena: Awesome. Thanks all — once assets land, I'll test the signup flow and run a quick localization sanity check. :spiral_calendar:
